alert.bypass.hint: Once the camera/job is fixed, go to Settings → Bypass inspection → Inspect again. Bypassed parts have status BYPASSED in the result CSV — tell QA to check that lot manually.
alert.plcDisconnected.hint: Check the network cable to the PLC, that the PLC is powered, and the IP/port in machine.json. MeoVision reconnects by itself once the PLC is back.
alert.savingFailed: Saving images/results is failing — {0} failed writes, {1} images dropped
alert.savingFailed.hint: The image drive may be full, removed or write-protected. See Settings → Storage and image saving (free space per drive) and the log. The machine still receives results.
AlertBar.title: Active alerts
device.notConnected.hint: Check the device cable/power and its entry in machine.json (camera serial, port, IP). MeoVision keeps retrying.
device.timeout.hint: The device did not answer in time: check cable and power, and that no other program is using it.
device.error.hint: See the log for details; if it repeats, power-cycle the device and wait for MeoVision to reconnect.
camera.gige.notFound.hint: GigE camera not found: check cable/PoE, that the NIC is on the camera's subnet (VisionPro GigE Configurator), and the serial in machine.json.
camera.grabFailed.hint: Missed frame: usually network overload or a loose cable. If frequent, check jumbo frames/packet size on the NIC.
cmd.laneBusy.hint: The camera was still busy with the previous command past the time limit: commands arrive too fast or the job is slow — see step times in the log.
cmd.timeout.hint: Command timed out: see in the log which step is slow (grab, job...). Raise the command's timeoutMs only if the machine can afford a longer cycle.
cmd.lightFailed.hint: Could not set the lights: check the light controller power and the COM port/IP in machine.json.
cmd.grabFailed.hint: Could not grab an image: test the camera in Camera & light (Grab once). If the camera is broken and the line must run, use Bypass inspection with manual checks.
cmd.jobError.hint: The VisionPro job reported an error: open Command setup and run it on the failing image to see which tool fails (dark image, pattern not found...).
cmd.noProduct.hint: No usable product: choose one in Products, or see the startup log for why it was rejected.
cmd.unknown.hint: The machine sent a code the running product does not have, or on the wrong channel: check the running product and the Channel column in Products.
cmd.outputMissing.hint: The job did not set this output this run (often an earlier tool did not run): check the job in Command setup.
startup.dataFolder.lowDisk.hint: Free up the drive holding the Data folder, or move images/logs to another drive in Settings → Storage and image saving.
startup.dataFolder.notWritable.hint: The Windows account running MeoVision cannot write to the Data folder: do not install under Program Files; check folder permissions.
startup.dataFolder.cloudSynced.hint: Copy the whole program folder (with Data) to a drive outside OneDrive, e.g. D:\MeoVision, and run MeoVision from there.
startup.dataFolder.fallBack.hint: The configured image/log drive does not exist on this PC (often after moving the drive to a new PC): fix the paths in Settings → Storage and image saving.
startup.settings.invalid.hint: Fix the syntax error in Data\settings.json (write \ as \\), restore settings.json.bak, or save again from Settings → Storage and image saving.
startup.vision.missing.hint: VisionPro license is missing a feature the jobs need: plug in the right dongle / activate the license on this PC (Cognex License Manager).
startup.storage.ok.hint: Image drive below the threshold: MeoVision deleted the oldest images. Keep fewer days, move images to a larger drive, or adjust the threshold in Settings → Storage and image saving.
release.changed.hint: A program file was replaced (DLL copied over?): reinstall the proper release. If it was a deliberate hotfix, package a new release.
release.missing.hint: A program file is missing: copy the complete release folder again.
release.extra.hint: An unknown DLL/EXE is in the program folder (two releases mixed?): remove it or reinstall cleanly.
release.none.hint: Running from a build folder (development PC). Production PCs run a release with release.json.
